aide.intro: Answers to the most common questions. Something else? Write to us, we reply quickly.
aide.q1r: Right after payment (usually within a few minutes), or on the date and at the time you chose (Paris time), up to one year ahead.
aide.q2: Can I send it directly to the person?
aide.q2r: Yes: at checkout, enter the recipient's email for each card. Otherwise, you receive it and pass it on yourself (forwarding the email, printing…).
aide.q3: I haven't received the card, what should I do?
aide.q3r: First check your spam folder. Then write to us via the <lien>contact page</lien> with the address used for the order: we will check and resend the card.
aide.q4: I entered the wrong email address
aide.q4r: Let us know as soon as possible. As long as a scheduled card has not been sent, we can correct the address. Once sent, its code can be used by whoever received it.
aide.q5: Where and how can the card be used?
aide.q5r: The code is used with the brand, online or in store depending on its terms, shown on each brand's page.
aide.q6: How long is the card valid?
aide.q6r: Validity depends on each brand. A question about a specific brand? Write to us before buying.
aide.q7r: We highlight brands that manufacture their products in France, not just brands of French origin. <lien>See these brands</lien>
aide.q8r: Online, by bank card and the other methods offered on Stripe's secure payment page. No fees are added: a €50 card costs €50.
aide.q9: Can I cancel or get a refund?
aide.q9r: As long as the card has not been sent (a scheduled card, for example), you can withdraw within 14 days using the <lien>withdrawal form</lien>. Once the code has been sent, this is no longer possible, as accepted when ordering.
aide.q10r: Write to us quickly with your order address. We check with the brand: a defective, unused card is replaced or refunded.
aide.q11: Do I need an account to order?
aide.q11r: No. But with a free account, your orders earn points, then cashback, and you find them all in one place.
aide.q12: How does the loyalty programme work?
aide.q12r: Every euro paid earns 1 point. Your points move you up the tiers, and from the Silver tier your orders earn cashback. Everything is explained on the <lien>Loyalty page</lien>.
aide.q13r: Use the <lien>Forgot your password</lien> link: you will receive an email to choose a new one.
aide.q14: How does a group gift work?
aide.q14r: You create the group gift and share the link. Everyone chips in what they like. On the end date, the total becomes a gift card. <lien>Start a group gift</lien>
aide.q15: What if the target isn't reached?
aide.q15r: The amount collected is still converted into a gift card on the end date. Contributions earn loyalty points, but not cashback.
aide.pasTrouveTexte: Write to us: we usually reply within 2 working days.
